scripts.text:
DELETE FROM Stg.AgilityOpenARFile
WHERE InvoiceChecksum IS NULL
SELECT @@ROWCOUNT as RowsDeleted

SELECT ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN ETLCreateDate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS RowsInserted
FROM [Stg].[AgilityOpenARFile] WHERE ETLExecutionID=0

QueryReadffromSrcDupe.defaultValue:
'--Ver:1.0-Initial
SELECT DISTINCT   [INVOICE #] = CAST([INVOICE #] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[InvoiceBK] = CAST([InvoiceBK] AS VARCHAR(100))

	,[CUST CODE] = CAST([CUST CODE] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[CUST Ship to] = CAST([CUST Ship to] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[PROJECT NUMBER] = CAST([PROJECT NUMBER] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[BRANCH] = CAST([BRANCH] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[SALES AGENT 1] = CAST([SALES AGENT 1] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[SALES AGENT 2] = CAST([SALES AGENT 2] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[INVOICED BY] = CAST([INVOICED BY] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[INV DATE] = CAST([INV DATE] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[DUE DATE] = CAST([DUE DATE] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[CREATED DATE] = CAST([CREATED DATE] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[OPEN A R] = CAST([OPEN A R] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[CBG CODE] = CAST([CBG CODE] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[JOURNAL #] = CAST([JOURNAL #] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[reference] = CAST([reference] AS VARCHAR(200))
	,[ORIGINAL AMOUNT] = CAST([ORIGINAL AMOUNT] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[TAX] = CAST([TAX] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[RETAINAGE] = CAST([RETAINAGE] AS VARCHAR(50))
	,[FileDate] = CAST([FileDate] AS VARCHAR(8))
	,[FileName] = CAST([FileName] AS VARCHAR(128))
FROM (
	SELECT   [INVOICE #]
		,[InvoiceBK]
 
		,[CUST CODE] = max([CUST CODE])
		,[CUST Ship to] = max([CUST Ship to])
		,[PROJECT NUMBER] = max([PROJECT NUMBER])
		,[BRANCH] = max([BRANCH])
		,[SALES AGENT 1] = max([SALES AGENT 1])
		,[SALES AGENT 2] = max([SALES AGENT 2])
		,[INVOICED BY] = max([INVOICED BY])
		,[INV DATE] = MIN(CAST([INV DATE] AS DATETIME))
		,[DUE DATE] = MIN(CAST([DUE DATE] AS DATETIME))
		,[CREATED DATE] = MIN(CAST([CREATED DATE] AS DATETIME))
		,[OPEN A R] = SUM(CAST( [OPEN A R]  AS DECIMAL(14, 4)))
		,[CBG CODE] = MAX([CBG CODE])
		,[JOURNAL #] = max([JOURNAL #])
		,[reference] = max([reference])
		,[ORIGINAL AMOUNT] = SUM(CAST([ORIGINAL AMOUNT] AS DECIMAL(14, 4)))
		,[TAX] = SUM(CAST([TAX] AS DECIMAL(14, 4)))
		,[RETAINAGE] = SUM(CAST([RETAINAGE] AS DECIMAL(14, 4)))
		,[FileDate]
		,[FileName] = MAX([FileName])
	FROM [Stg].[AgilityOpenARFile] WITH (NOLOCK)
	WHERE [INVOICE #] <> ''
	GROUP BY [INVOICE #]
		,[InvoiceBK]
		,[FileDate]
	) x'
